# Fit-view contract provenance

`fit-view-contract.json` is an original Chromarchy viewport geometry contract.
Its asymmetric 400×200 document independently identifies the width-limited
unrotated fit and height-limited quarter-turned fit, while the 300,000-square
sparse case fixes the existing minimum-zoom clamp rather than implying that
the zoom architecture changed.

The fixture defines a one-shot display operation only. Image pixels,
selection, history, dirty state, storage, and native persistence are unchanged.
